chunks: Whatever is in it from Mirāzim ibn Ḥakīm, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Mirāzim ibn Ḥakīm.

key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: May Allah be pleased with him; an honorific supplication for the named narrator.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s direct statement of narration.
key_terms.عَنْ مِرَازِمِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ: From Mirāzim ibn Ḥakīm; identifies the source narrator of this transmission line.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from Mirāzim ibn Ḥakīm in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage records the transmission chain through which the author narrates reports from Mirāzim ibn Ḥakīm. Its significance lies in documenting the sanad/isnad for hadith attribution in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh.
